summary: @servicetitan/anvil2-codemods preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: package.json declares preinstall=`node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is itself identifier- and string-obfuscated (hex-mangled variable names, per-function string-mapping proxy objects in obfuscator.io style). At install time it resolves a platform-specific Bun build, downloads bun-v1.3.13 from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, unzips it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it with the sibling file `math_init.js` as its argument via execFileSync. `math_init.js` is a 727KB single-line `// @bun @bun-cjs` bundle protected by a shuffled string array rotated by a helper function and a custom-alphabet character decoder over ~1800 constant entries; it contains no readable strings and has no relation to the declared jscodeshift codemod purpose. Together this is the alternate-runtime dropper shape: fetching Bun to execute an opaque bundled blob at install time bypasses Node-based scanning, and neither the runtime download nor the obfuscated payload is required for a codemod utility.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
